# middmonitor_organization (Data Source)

Reads the current organization (from JWT + `org_slug` in the provider).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "middmonitor_organization" "current" {}

output "org_plan" {
  value = data.middmonitor_organization.current.plan
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Organization ID.
- `name` (String) Organization display name.
- `plan` (String) Subscription plan of the organization, e.g. `free` or `pro`.
- `slug` (String) Organization slug, the URL segment used by the API.
